stylePanel.noSelection: Select a component to edit its styles
resize.doubleClickHint: Drag to resize; double-click to fill space
layout.mode.label: Layout direction
layout.mode.help: Default: items follow their natural size and flow. Stacked: items form a column. Side by side: items form a row. These last two options let you adjust alignment and spacing.
layout.advanced.label: CSS layout method
layout.advanced.help: block: natural flow. flex: a row or column layout. grid: a row and column layout. Selecting grid alone does not create columns; existing row and column definitions are preserved.
layout.alignment.label: Cross-axis alignment
layout.distribution.label: Along the flow
layout.gap.label: Space between items
spacing.layoutOverride: Layout spacing is active. Change its uniform or custom values in Layout.
startup.title: Welcome to UI Designer
startup.subtitle: How would you like to start today?
startup.fresh.title: Start fresh
startup.fresh.description: Begin with a clean canvas and build your design.
startup.templates.title: My designs
startup.templates.description: Continue with one of your previously saved designs.

tree.empty: No components yet. Drag a component here.
canvas.emptySlot: Empty slot (add components from the right panel)
canvas.emptyContainerSpacing: Adjust spacing in the right panel
canvas.cyclicSlot: This design links back to itself. Remove the circular link.
slot.itemDesignHint: Choose the design used for each list record from My components.
slotBuilder.singleRootWarning: This slot accepts one root component. Add child components inside the root component.

slotBuilder.noSelection: Select an item from the preview or tree to edit its properties and appearance.

dataTableEditor.title: Table editor
toolbar.fitTitle: Fit the canvas to the available width
responsive.helpDescription: The selected width scopes layout and responsive-enabled properties. Smaller widths inherit wider values unless overridden. Text, data and event connections are shared across views.
behavior.pagePlaceholder: Describe how this page should work. Example: Load the user list when the page opens and support infinite scrolling.
behavior.componentPlaceholder: Describe how this component should work. Example: Clear the district selection and load new districts when the province changes.
behavior.exportHint: This description is passed to the coding agent.
annotation.deleteMessage: This behavior will be deleted. Do you want to delete it?
annotation.title: Short title (optional)
annotation.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Clear district when province changes
interaction.title: Flow connection
interaction.initiallyHidden: Hide this item when preview starts
behaviors.title: All behaviors
behaviors.searchPlaceholder: Search text, component, or page path...
behaviors.empty: No behaviors have been added yet. Right-click the page or a component to add one.
behaviors.selectHint: Select a behavior to view its details.
adapter.label: UI library
adapter.hint: Each library keeps a separate design.
flow.title: Flows
flow.name: Flow name
flow.formHint: Complete one form in several steps.
flow.empty: Choose a screen to edit. Use the pencil to rename it.
flow.noConnections: Right-click a button and choose “Connect to flow”. Then choose a screen or window.
flow.exportHint: TSX and manifest JSON describe the same connections, meanings and visibility changes. Export flat JSON from the File menu to include the complete design and contract together.
interaction.intentHint: Form step changes the step. Page navigation changes the page. State change shows another frame of the same page.
flow.manifestIssues: Some form connections have ambiguous screen contexts. Review the issues listed in the manifest before generating a form provider.
window.name: Overlay name
window.initiallyOpen: Open when this screen is shown
window.designHint: You can select closed popups from the list to edit them.
condition.simulationHint: Example results simulate responses; no real service request is sent. Change them before trying the action again.
condition.invalidInput: Complete or correct the condition field
condition.invalidDraft: Check the condition, comparison value and both targets.
toggleBinding.title: Show fields on this screen
toggleBinding.hint: Select the fields to control, then choose when each one should be shown.
toggleBinding.exclusiveHint: These pairs work both ways: the last switch turned on wins. Turning it off does not reopen others. Unselected switches stay independent.
visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.hint: Stays visible while designing. In preview, your chosen condition controls visibility.
flow.deleteScreenHint: This screen and its contents will be deleted. You can restore them with Undo.
flow.deleteGroupHint: All screens and contents in this group will be deleted. You can restore them with Undo.
canvas.panHint: Hold Space and drag the workspace.
canvas.handToolHint: Drag the workspace to move your view; components stay in place.
canvas.horizontalScrollHint: Hold Shift and use the mouse wheel.
canvas.zoomShortcutHint: Hold Ctrl (or ⌘ on Mac) and use the mouse wheel.
preview.newTab: Open preview in a new tab
preview.blocked: The preview tab could not open. Allow popups for this site and try again.
preview.missing: This preview is no longer available. Return to the designer and open Preview again.
frame.contextHint: This screen is a design and flow context. Select a component inside it, or add a Card / Box to style its content.
textBinding.hint: Sample text appears only in the design. Leave it empty to use the component content text. Preview shows the bound field value, or the content text when the field is empty.
interaction.closeCurrentHint: Closes this window and stays on the screen behind it.
interaction.createWindowHint: Add a Modal or Toast from Components → Overlays, then connect it here.
interaction.createScreenHint: First add a screen using New screen.
interaction.saved: Connection saved. You can try it with Preview.
interaction.actionHelp: Choose which screen to visit or which window to open or close when this component is used.
interaction.targetHelp: Choose the screen to visit or the window to open or close. Only compatible targets are listed.
componentState.title: Visibility and availability
componentState.help: Visibility controls whether the item is shown. Availability controls whether a visible item can be used. Bind conditions to fields on this screen, such as a checked switch or completed inputs. Try the changes in preview.
componentState.legacyAction: This legacy show/hide connection is preserved. Create new visibility conditions on the affected item under Visibility and availability.
componentState.noFields: Add an input, checkbox or switch to this screen to bind a condition.
newFlow.title: Switch to a New Flow
newFlow.warning: Your current design will be kept and a new workspace design will be opened.
newFlow.saveHint: Changes are saved automatically in this browser.
newFlow.saveDesignHint: Reopen your current design from File → My designs.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.scope: Design editing shortcuts are inactive in preview and while a menu or dialog is open. While typing in text fields, copy, paste and undo apply to the text.
reference.title: References
reference.help: Upload a screenshot, then ask the IDE Designer agent to recreate it using the selected UI library. MCP supplies the image, catalog and guides. The result is appended as new screens and can be undone. Images stay in this browser and are not included in design JSON. Transfer again after restarting MCP.
reference.instructions: Drop an image here or onto the workspace. Compare the result beside it.
reference.empty: PNG, JPG or WebP · Up to 8 images, 10 MB each. Long edge is reduced to 4096 px.
reference.drop: Drop to add a reference image
reference.storageError: Could not save the image in this browser. Check available storage.
reference.invalidType: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP file.
reference.tooLarge: Images must be at most 10 MB and 24 megapixels. Choose a smaller image.
reference.invalidImage: The file is not a readable image.
reference.limit: Up to 8 references can be stored. Remove one first.
reference.syncError: Image is saved in this browser. Connect Designer to MCP and check agent access again.
reference.removeSyncError: Local image removed. Use Transfer after reconnecting to reconcile the remote list.
reference.cancelled: Transfer cancelled. Saved images remain in this browser.
reference.operation.rejected: Update rejected · Ask the agent to read the current design
reference.canvasHelp: Drag the image to move it. All resize handles keep its proportions. Shift-click to select multiple images; Delete removes them. Arrow keys move, +/− resize.
recovery.title: Saved design could not be loaded
recovery.description: This record contains unsupported component properties. The design was not applied. Download the original JSON, correct the reported fields and import it again.
tableAuthoring.derivedHint: Determined automatically from non-empty cells in the column.
tableAuthoring.hint: Select a cell to edit text, add components or copy content from the right panel. Use + to append rows/columns, or right-click to insert between them.
tableAuthoring.paletteHint: To add to this cell, choose a component from the Components tab on the left. Select a component inside the cell to edit its properties and behavior.
tableAuthoring.copyHint: The entire selected cell content replaces the other cells. Copies can be edited independently. Use Undo to restore the previous content. Behaviors targeting outside the cell are not copied.
collectionAuthoring.tabsHint: Select a title to design its content. Editing selection does not change the preview starting tab.
collectionAuthoring.listHint: Design the first item directly. Each new item starts as an independent copy of the last item.
collectionAuthoring.contentHint: Add from the Components panel. Select text or a component inside to edit its properties.
collectionAuthoring.copyHint: Copies are independent. Behaviors targeting outside the item are not copied. Undo restores an operation.
collectionAuthoring.title: Tab title
collectionAuthoring.saveGroupHint: Save the group or components inside the item
disclosure.title: Expandable section
disclosure.heading: Section heading
disclosure.hint: Opening or closing in the editor does not change the preview starting state.
disclosure.contentHint: Add content from the Components panel. Select a component inside to edit its properties.
responsive.deviceFramesHelp: Show device frames. Does not change the design or exported content.
responsive.linkedView: Linked screens · Edit at this width
responsive.propertiesScope: Content applies across views. Responsive properties are edited at the selected width.
responsive.sharedPropertiesScope: Changes apply to all views of the selected components.
editorEntry.checking.title: Opening Designer
editorEntry.blocked.title: Designer is open in another tab
editorEntry.blocked.description: This version supports one design at a time. Close the other Designer tab, then retry here. Your latest saved design stays in this browser.
editorEntry.unavailable.title: Designer needs a secure connection
editorEntry.unavailable.description: Use localhost or HTTPS in a current browser. The single editor check could not start.
editorEntry.storageError.title: Local design storage could not open
editorEntry.storageError.description: Browser storage is unavailable or the saved design could not be validated. The editor did not open to preserve your data. Check storage settings, then retry.
header.mcp.conflict: This connection ID is already active in another editor
workspace.failed: The operation could not complete. Check your open design; try Save again or export as JSON.
workspace.copyFailed: Could not copy ID. Check browser clipboard permissions.
workspace.switchConflict: The design changed during switching. Your edits were preserved; select again.
cellDesigner.title: Design cell
cellDesigner.hint: Drag components into the workspace. Finish applies this cell; Cancel discards the draft. Saving a custom component keeps a separate copy.
cellDesigner.scope: Layout and responsive properties: {breakpoint}. Content is shared.
cellDesigner.error: Could not apply this draft. The cell may have changed or been removed, or the content may be invalid. Close and reopen the cell to try again.
header.selectedFramesHelp: Use the selection button beside a screen title; Ctrl/⌘ adds other screens. Partial or mixed selections cannot be exported. Actions to unselected screens are omitted.
flow.selectWholeScreenHint: Select or deselect this screen with all its responsive views. You can check multiple screens.
colors.title: Colors
colors.borderHint: Border color applies when a visible border is present.
workspace.localHint: Saved designs are stored in this browser. Export as JSON to move them to another browser or computer.
workspace.saveFailed: Could not save. Try Save again or export as JSON.
workspace.preferenceFailed: Could not save the auto-save preference. Try again.
workspace.replaceHint: The workspace content will change. Previously saved designs remain in My designs.
workspace.unsavedWarning: You have unsaved changes. Continuing without saving will discard those changes.
